CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition is bound to the identified content.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates, an explicit presentation/orientation statement, and a separate origin/status entry are all present for the same p0/current/n3 referent.

A.rationale: Report lists candidate/command/feedback metadata but provides no explicit attention/allocation claim linked to a content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (red/blue) with coordinate sets are present.

D.rationale: Origins/kind fields and inherited/current distinctions separately attribute status/source metadata apart from the coordinate content.

O.rationale: Coordinate sets and an explicit statement about rows/columns describe how content is presented/organized.
